seo.title: Website Case Studies | SynergyFirst Digital
seo.metaDescription: Website case studies from SynergyFirst Digital: an optician, a nonprofit, a casting portal, a book publisher, a production company and an EV charging provider.
seo.ogDescription: How we designed and built websites for six businesses, and what each one includes.

sections.subheading: Six websites we have designed and built, from a local optician to a casting platform. Each case study explains what the site needed to do and what it includes.

sections.heading: Website design case studies by industry
sections.intro: Every project starts with the business and its visitors. These case studies show how that thinking became a website, across eye-care retail, nonprofit, entertainment, publishing and clean energy.

sections.heading: Want your business to be our next case study?
